corpus.0-0: Error MQ2035 is returned when a client attempts to connect to a queue manager with credentials that are not authorised for the channel. Verify the channel authentication record and the client user identifier.
corpus.1-0: The connection pool exhausts when the maximum pool size is reached and all connections are in use. Increase maxPoolSize or reduce connection hold time; the default is 50.
corpus.2-0: To collect a first-failure data capture, run the fdc tool with the -a flag. The archive is written to the diagnostics directory.
corpus.3-0: Certificate expiry causes handshake failure with error SSL0208E. Renew the personal certificate in the key database and restart the listener.
corpus.4-0: Log files rotate at 100 MB by default and ten generations are retained. Both values are configurable in the logging stanza.
corpus.5-0: A queue depth alert fires when current depth exceeds the high-depth threshold for longer than the alert interval.
